threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus will take you to where you need to go on time, bless your heart. It's all about the overland or a good pair of shoes here.
Caught a glimpse of a guy in a duck costume dancing with a street performer at Brixton bus stop last weekend. Only in South London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a spontaneous Blockade in the street for a rave, locals bringing out potties and a grill, and everyone just vibing like it's a normal Saturday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s common to see people sipping coffee at the corner while discussing last night’s underground film screening — a vibe unlike anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to avoid the BART during rush hour, especially after a loud bang or smoke at Civic Center. They know it’s not just transit; it’s survival.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a lady singing opera on the 31 while a guy next to her tried to sell his mixtape. Just another Tuesday in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume all the trendy bars in Gràcia are overpriced. But there are hidden gems where you can still grab a caña for under 2 euros if you know where to look.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the lack of a timetable at the bus stops. The locals just know when to show up.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus will get you across town quicker than the Tube. Welcome to Dalston, mate; it’s not that simple.
Last night on the 59, a lad pulled out an electric guitar and started strumming. The driver just shook his head but we all loved it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a hipster arguing with an old man over who makes better Döner at Hermannplatz. Classic Neukölln, where stories meet at every corner.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar where they serve currywurst on tap while they blast 90s techno. It's a wild fusion of flavors and beats!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're local if they carry a reusable bag filled with takeout from La Taqueria while dodging the latest BART delays on their way home.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, a pigeon casually strolled onto the 31 bus, ignoring the driver’s honk. Classic Tenderloin moment, perfectly capturing our daily chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bar for tapas, but the best ones in Gràcia often require a reservation weeks in advance. It’s a locals' secret.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewildered faces while staring at the metro map like it’s a puzzle, especially around Passeig de Gràcia.
